title: Do archived LP2 texts supply signature dates for a public pad?
question: Does C8 Step 0 find a PGP signature creation time attached to each LP2 decrypt target in its two preserved textual inputs?
summary: All eight signature blocks occur in LP1. Neither the LP2 Markdown portion nor the 57-segment runic transcription contains signature armor, so these texts supply no per-target-page timestamp join.
reader_question: Do these archived texts give a signature date for each encrypted page?
reader_finding: Eight signature blocks contain seven distinct clock values, and all eight occur in LP1. The two LP2 text inputs supply no per-page signature date.
reader_limit: This checks the preserved texts, not every historical image or distribution. It performs no pad decoding; signature clock values are not independently authenticated release dates.
finding: Unchanged source Step 0 reproduces eight blocks/seven seconds. Independent packet parsing agrees exactly and explicitly locates all eight within LP1. The LP2 Markdown portion has 24 grouped headings, no signature armor, and page labels through 57; the distinct runic file has 57 segments and no armor.
limitations: This is an input-extraction and join-availability finding, not a cryptanalytic negative. No new GnuPG verification, beacon authentication, external fetch or 630-row decoder replay was performed. The two text inventories do not prove absence of per-page signatures from all historical artifacts.
next_steps: Supply an independently justified timestamp-to-target join and exact archived pad inputs before a dated-pad replay.

scope.representation: Exact pinned Git bytes of C8 Step 0 and its two textual inputs, then Markdown indentation removal and explicit LP1/LP2 heading boundaries.
scope.parameters: 8 signature blocks; 7 distinct creation seconds; 24 grouped LP2 headings; 57 percent-delimited rune segments.
scope.procedure: Run source Step 0 unchanged in a temporary input tree, compare complete saved JSON, independently parse packet lengths and creation subpackets and attribute blocks to explicit book-part headings.
scope.exclusions: Historical image-wide signature absence, authorship and release-date authentication, random-pad retrieval, I2 adjudication, source 630-test claims and LP2 decryption.

review.kind: bounded source extraction and independent packet/section check
review.reviewer: Unchanged source extractor and independent standard-library parser
